text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan wasn't feeling well, so I 
decided to have her rest in the nurse's 
office...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real? I can just sleep in bed? Oh man, 
that's seriously a lifesaver~. Thank ya.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pass it here, pass! Shoooo...t?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... I can't launch off the ground at 
all... I mean, my legs feel so heavy...!

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team Gal A
text_block_list.text:
Kyahaha! You really think you can take us 
on with such weak nails~?

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team Gal B
text_block_list.text:
A Gal Basketball Tournament?! Isn't that, 
like, 10 billion years too early~~?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The hell did you say...!?
STOOOOOP! HEY Jordan, chill out and GO!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gah!? Who the heck are y—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wait, could that ridiculously rugged 
bottle be...!?

text_block_list.name: Hoof Reinforcement EX
text_block_list.text:
YEAH! Your best buddy, your nail's best 
friend!! "Athlete Nail Reinforcement Hyper 
Guard EX"!

text_block_list.name: Hoof Reinforcement EX
text_block_list.text: Come on, use me! DO IT!!
(Sha-la-la-la-la~♪)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: H-Huh!? What is this...!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This feels so, sooo good!! Alright! Eat 
this, three-pointer!

text_block_list.name: Hoof Reinforcement EX
text_block_list.text:
GREAT! Nice shot! I'll be cheering you on 
from here on out, too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hell yeaaah!! Let's do this!!

Tosen Jordan returned to training looking 
refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...? Nothin's happenin' though...

text_block_list.name: Hoof Reinforcement EX
text_block_list.text:
NOOO! How could I let this happen?! It's 
hardened inside the bottle... You've got 
to be kidding me!?

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team Gals
text_block_list.text:
Kyahaha! Forgetting to close the lid 
properly is so lame! Here goes, slam 
dunk!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ngaaah!! What is their problem?! So 
annoying! I totally zipped it up!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...It's closed anyway. Probably.

Having had such a frustrating dream, Tosen 
Jordan's condition remained unrecovered...
